mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, it signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows by >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% year-over-year, it signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth > 20% but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp in 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month UNRATE rise > 0.5pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index are both rising, it signals a tightening of financial conditions that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth and retail sales are both accelerating, it signals a strengthening economy that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both accelerating but SPX 60-day returns are negative >40% of the time.
